# Data
- `ensembl_gene_set_hg38_v115.csv`: Processed Ensembl gene set from Ensembl v115 on GRCh38/
- `ensembl_genes_v115_uniprot.csv`: Mapping ENSG IDs from the Ensembl gene set (from Ensembl v115) to UniProt IDs
- `ensembl_genes_v115_ncbi.csv`: Mapping ENSG IDs from the Ensembl gene set (from Ensembl v115) to NCBI IDs
